title: Waters
summary: US maker of liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry systems.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Waters sells chromatography columns, mass spectrometers and informatics used for drug characterisation and quality control. Its consumables and service revenue is recurring, while instrument sales follow lab capex. The company has been expanding into clinical and bioseparation applications.

Technology Exposure

  • Liquid chromatography
  • Mass spectrometry
  • Columns, consumables and service

What To Watch

  • Pharma R&D and QC spending
  • Instrument replacement cycle
  • China demand

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
